diagnostics.composite_formula: sum_{nonempty d in {0,1}^3} P(d)*mean(g_c for d_c=1) / P(any d_c=1)
diagnostics.gap_composite: R and B use the mean of their defined gap-channel idea outputs; POI averages available F and Est gap-channel means

probability_inputs.assumption: fixed convex probability mixtures; component events are not asserted independent, and probabilities are uncalibrated proxies, never hard flags
probability_inputs.building: scaled Poisson nonempty proxy from Sca3 exclusive OSM/Esri centroid-assigned footprint count
probability_inputs.establishments: scaled Poisson nonempty proxy from Sca3 non-Microsoft provided-place count; mean with facility proxy
probability_inputs.facility: fixed arithmetic mean of P2 Poisson nonempty probability, scaled P3 school-witness probability, and registered X1 soft probability
probability_inputs.road: mean of scaled P4/observed named-road-km proxy and scaled X4 witness proxy
